label: Counterfactual guidance and self-application against imitability exemplars (#2145 lane C round 3)
summary: See docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md, section 'Counterfactual guidance and self-application against imitability exemplars'. Follows attempt 421caba9 (round 2), which left the containment-recognition bridge d1fb6414 at parity with A4 (contained, individuating, value-ranked modes of imitability guiding favouring, not apprehended). A4 is defined as a structural duplicate of the personal source, so parity on structural tests follows from round 2's definitions and is not further evidence. Owner-approved tests, applied identically to both, in their strongest encoded forms. (1) Counterfactual guidance with graded respect weights: an outweighed reason guides when raising it alone (RaisesOnly, other respects and candidates fixed) makes the favouring follow it. Placed diagnostic 1587c760 (guidanceTable, tests d1fb6414): the good-tracking profile (shared) is guided; a fit-blind profile and a fixed favouring meet the outweighed condition and are not guided; a fit-only nature faces no outweighed fit reason; the second-order standard ranks the good-tracking over the fit-blind profile. Lean-only: respectBlindNotGuided, singleRespectTrackerNotGuided (a one-respect tracker is guided by no outweighed reason; the D-nature's form only when its end content is one respect of a graded value), guidanceOfTracking, guidanceLabelIndependent, fixedNotGuided, degreeOnlyRegistersNoRespectBetweenTies. Registration of outweighed respects was argued, not tested; it needs per-respect stand-ins, a new commitment for A4 (per-respect modes) and an analyst extension for the personal account (per-respect ideas); the antecedent will and a mode's own degree are per-candidate degrees and do not register a respect. (2) Self-application: weak form (SelfApplies, own favouring over a determination d) reduces, when d is not had, to the criterion at second order (selfApplicationIndividuates); strong form (SelfAppliesToStandard, responsiveness to the second-order standard SecondOrderStandard) is scenario-invariant, so no second-order profile depends on it (secondOrderStandardNotDependedOn): a fixed second-order orientation for both. Self-love available to both (q.19 a.3; for the rival an analyst posit, Plotinus Enn. VI.8.15 navigation only, with quasi-intellective language there); ranking possible alternatives to its own favouring unavailable to both at a necessary source; self-apprehension presupposes the dispute. Symmetry: same articulation demand (#1879), different proposed payments: a plurality in being understood (personal) versus a mind-independent, non-composing plurality multiplied per respect (A4, #1892). Rejected: the weak guidance test (passed by a respect-blind profile); 'further mark the D-nature fails' for Lane 2b's non-Fixed dNature; guidance or registration as evidence of mind; self-apprehension as discriminator; necessity of self-favouring against A4. Semantic challenge of ad289e982..8a36e93f0 (three P1, five P2) repaired in the following commit.
blocker: Structural tests cannot separate A4 from the personal source, since A4 is a structural duplicate by definition. The discriminating question is the coherence of A4's payment: can a plurality of value-ranked, respect-articulated modes in a simple nature be mind-independent and non-composing at once, or does it need a unifying principle that only being understood supplies (#1879 with #1892)? Further: a non-counterpossible analogue of error and correction at a necessary source; explanatory use of the modes requiring them to be for the source.

current_assessment.scope: Owner-approved round-3 tests of the gap between imitability exemplars (A4) and apprehension: counterfactual guidance by outweighed reasons and self-application, applied identically to the personal source
current_assessment.assessment: No change at d1fb6414. Both owner-approved tests, in their strongest encoded forms (guidance with the outweighed reason raised alone; self-application to the second-order standard), fail to separate A4 from the personal source; because A4 is defined as a structural duplicate, that parity follows from round 2's definitions and is not further evidence. Guidance separates good-tracking favouring from respect-blind and fixed favouring (respectBlindNotGuided, fixedNotGuided) and a one-respect tracker is never guided (singleRespectTrackerNotGuided; the D-nature's form only when its end content is one respect of a graded value). Strong self-application is a fixed second-order orientation for both (secondOrderStandardNotDependedOn); weak self-application reduces to the criterion at second order. Registration was argued, not tested; per-respect modes are a new commitment for A4. The two accounts face the same articulation demand with different proposed payments: a plurality in being understood versus a mind-independent, non-composing plurality (#1892), now per respect.
